title: 1990 Donruss Base Set #710 Ozzie Smith All Stars Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1990 Donruss sports trading card features Ozzie Smith, a major league baseball player from the St. Louis Cardinals team. The card is made of high-quality card stock material and is an original piece from the Donruss manufacturer. It is part of the base set and has a card number of 710.

The card is in standard size and is perfect for any collector or fan of baseball. This trading card is not autographed and is not a custom bundle. It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and is a must-have for fans of the St. Louis Cardinals.
